## What's new in v0.2.5

- Added image downloads: hover a loaded image and click the download button in its bottom-right corner to save the original file to Downloads. Repeated downloads receive numbered filenames without overwriting existing files.
- Image downloads support linked and responsive images, generated blob/data images, CSS backgrounds, and embedded frames, including split tabs. Browser-session downloads handle many images that page scripts cannot read directly.
- Improved image detection on Instagram and other galleries with transparent covers, carousels, and lazy-loaded feeds. The button follows visible photos as you scroll, without needing to open the comments view.
- Expanded tab context menus with **Refresh**, **Duplicate tab**, **Mute tab / Unmute tab**, **Close tabs to the right**, **Close tabs to the left**, and **Reopen closed tab**. Actions target the selected page, including background and split pages.
- Fixed existing tabs briefly shrinking or blinking when creating or reopening a tab. New tabs retain their entry animation.
- Fixed repeated **Ctrl + F4** tab closing when focus moves between native browser pages.
- Added persistent bookmarks and folders, native bookmark editing, context-menu actions, and drag-to-reorder support for the bookmarks bar and folder contents.

## Windows installers

Choose either the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** from the assets below. Both install AuraView v0.2.5 for Windows x64.
